<<Mending Of Fishing Nets, Briefly>>

The community is encouraged to participate in the mending of fishing nets as part of our collective effort to preserve marine resources and support sustainable fishing practices. Local fishermen and community members are invited to bring damaged nets for repair, which not only helps in recovering valuable fishing equipment but also reduces waste and promotes environmental responsibility. This initiative fosters unity and ensures that our fishing practices remain eco-friendly and efficient. Let’s work together to keep our waters healthy and our community strong.
